scripts.build: bun install --cwd packages/worker --backend=copyfile && bun install --cwd apps/web --backend=copyfile && bun run build:web
scripts.deploy: npx wrangler deploy && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.test: bun --cwd packages/worker test && bun --cwd apps/web test
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build:web
scripts.typecheck: bun --cwd packages/worker typecheck && bun --cwd apps/web typecheck
